description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pitipana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520006 (24/0218)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as specified in Type 4 classification criteria.
